toolReferencePaths: Resolve repository-relative image references to absolute local paths before calling image_gen; unbased paths are rejected. Persistent records use repository-relative paths and SHA-256 values.
pathBase: repository root, except preview outputs beside this manifest
generationTool: built-in image_gen; one image per call; no CLI/API fallback without explicit permission
generationRecord: Each generations entry records tool, exactPrompt (commonPrompt + location prompt + actual edits), rawImage path, reference image paths and their SHA-256 values. visualReview records imageSha256, reviewer, inspected preview paths and notes; art-ready requires a review matching the selected image.

Modern tourism photograph: rocky spur only. Restored roofed tower, regular new battlements, railings and flag explicitly excluded from art.
Archival March 1943 view of broken railway span and improvised foot crossing. Znaci archive general public-domain notice; no whole side elevation inferred.

Modern tourist panorama: distant forested canyon and pale rocky mountain silhouette only; no tourists or equipment.

Modern tourism photograph, credited Predrag Vuckovic by filename: close-up Pobednik silhouette and a river arm only, not a fortress panorama. No modern skyline or boats; reference, not game texture.
Aerial photo of rounded wooded spurs, deciduous/conifer patches and stream valleys. Natural relief and vegetation only; omit modern structures and roads.
Modern garden-side fortress view: masonry rampart and distant Pobednik column only. Not a confluence panorama. Omit tourists, formal planting beds, paths, fixtures and current fences.

commonPrompt: Create one finished opaque landscape pixel-art background for a WWII Yugoslavia artillery/tank game. The two supplied project images are STYLE AND FRAMING references, not edit targets. Match their crisp pixel clusters, restrained natural colors, damaged period masonry, atmospheric distance and low side-view combat strip; do not make a smooth photograph or a flat geometric placeholder. Aim for a landscape canvas around 3:2; keep the actual delivered dimensions and never crop away landmarks to force a size. Make the far edge of a wide, level, dry foreground combat strip a perfectly horizontal line around 80.6 percent of image height. Keep the lower foreground and the band immediately above that line quiet, fairly light and low in small details across the entire width, so dark soldiers, cannons and tanks remain readable anywhere along it. Put distinctive landmarks and sharp grouped details in the middle distance, inside the central 80 percent of the canvas. Leave the upper corners and bottom corners visually calm for existing game overlays. Water, cliffs, trenches, wire and rubble remain BEHIND the playable foreground, never crossing the combat strip. Show clear WWII war damage in the middle distance, appropriate to this location. Keep the playable foreground empty. Small background soldiers and/or civilians are allowed where appropriate: a supported lookout or machine-gun position, a patrol, or people sheltering and moving between cover. Stage a few readable distant groups; moving people need separate animated layers for production. No UI, captions, logos or borders. Environmental wartime graffiti and partisan flags are allowed when appropriate to the place and scene: paint graffiti onto damaged walls and mount flags on buildings, not as overlaid labels. Include purposeful soot-blackened wall patches, charred roof beams and grouped battle scars, beyond merely damaged roofs. No modern buildings, memorial complexes, highways, powerlines, tourist platforms or modern bridges. NO painted flames, smoke plumes, sparks or glowing fires anywhere: draw cold charred damage instead; game code will animate effects later. This is a landscape homage with compressed geography, not a claim of a documented battle or tank deployment at this exact viewpoint. Preserve location-specific recognizable forms from the historical notes.
artChecks: Inspect each generated image before selecting it: landmarks, period, absence of baked smoke/fire, level ground, coherent pixel style and quiet unit zone.
Record actual width, height and measured source-pixel groundY, not the requested dimensions or an assumed percentage.

hotspots is null until reviewed; thereafter list measured {x,y,intensity,kind} entries, with intensity in (0,1], kind fire or smoke. Coordinates have origin at source top-left. Empty list only after an explicit no-hotspot decision with another live-ambience handoff.
Record the exact prompt, reference snapshots and raw output of each generation in generations; do not overwrite rejected attempts.
Use prepare.py to make two unit compositions per viewport and a local preview.html. Inspect PNGs directly; browser execution is not authorized.
Do not mark art ready until both scene compositions are visually reviewed; preview is an art composition study, not execution or acceptance of the game.

Claude integrates shared background mapping, hotspots, wind, scene time, pause and outcomes; no Storybook entry for these backgrounds. Overall ART-12 stays open until its in-game acceptance condition is met.

backgrounds.name: Bihać
backgrounds.prompt: Una: emerald channels, pale tufa ledges and broad low white-water cascades in the middle distance. Show the squat old stone Kapetanova kula with a steep dark hipped roof and small openings among low period town roofs, not a fantasy turret. Compress town and river motifs as an homage, without pretending the large distant Strbacki Buk waterfall sits next to the tower. Include roofless damaged ordinary houses and a broken low riverbank wall. Keep the tower recognizable and structurally legible rather than arbitrarily destroying it; damage belongs on adjacent ordinary structures. Dry quiet light-earth foreground below the riverbank.

visualReview.notes: Tower silhouette, cascades and wartime damage read clearly; uninterrupted flat ground, quiet unit backdrop, no painted smoke or flame. Both scene compositions inspected in both viewports; not a game runtime check.

backgrounds.name: Užice
backgrounds.prompt: Djetinja curves around a steep rocky spur carrying the RUINS of the Stari grad fortress. The old town of low plastered houses with tiled roofs lies in a narrow green valley beyond. Fortress walls are irregular old ruins, not today's reconstructed complete visitor tower. Add broken roof timbers and shell-damaged ordinary valley houses away from the foreground. No modern suspension footbridge, motorway, concrete apartment blocks or tourist infrastructure. Retain a quiet dry near-bank combat strip.

visualReview.notes: Old roofless citadel ruins on the Djetinja crag; damaged period houses, no reconstructed tower or modern flag. Flat unobstructed combat strip and readable units in both scene compositions and both viewports. Not game execution.

backgrounds.name: Neretva
backgrounds.prompt: Jablanica: a steep rocky Neretva gorge with green-blue water and the broken EARLY railway bridge of March 1943, its dark iron lattice span collapsed steeply toward the water with a clear gap and surviving masonry abutments. Use a verified 1943 archival view for the broken-span silhouette; do not copy the later replacement bridge, the 1968 film bridge or today's memorial pedestrian walkway. Do not paint a complete passable railway bridge, museum, memorial train display, modern road bridge or reservoir. Period houses and a ruined railway-side wall in the middle distance. River and collapsed bridge are behind a continuous dry foreground terrace.

visualReview.notes: Broken early iron railway span falls into river from masonry abutment; no complete crossing, memorial or modern bridge. Period roof damage and calm dry foreground. All four unit compositions inspected; effects and runtime not executed.

backgrounds.name: Drvar
backgrounds.prompt: A broad Drvar basin with low red-roofed period houses below a wooded limestone escarpment. Make a clearly readable dark cave mouth under a natural rock overhang the focal feature, with a modest rough timber shelter only if supported by the chosen wartime reference. Cave belongs on the cliff above town, not a tunnel in the flat battlefield. Show damaged ordinary roofs, a splintered tree and a broken timber fence in the middle distance. No postwar museum buildings, monumental stairways, visitor railings or souvenir facilities. Quiet level basin foreground.

visualReview.notes: Visible natural cave above the basin, damaged period houses, snapped tree and broken fence; modern hut and visitor fixtures omitted. Four unit compositions inspected; clear combat strip, no baked smoke/fire. Not game execution.

backgrounds.name: Sutjeska
backgrounds.prompt: Layered forested Zelengora ridges and the deep Sutjeska canyon frame the distant sharper pale rocky summit of Maglic. A compressed but believable mountain-valley panorama, not one generic snowy alpine wall and not a lakeside Durmitor scene. Show a damaged small stone-and-timber mountain house, snapped trees and an abandoned shallow timber-lined position in the middle distance. No Tjentiste wing monument, concrete memorial, postwar hotel or modern park road. The near valley terrace is quiet, light and horizontal; dense woodland stays behind it.

visualReview.notes: Forested canyon and prominent pale rocky peak distinguish the high mountain setting. Roofless house, snapped trunks and abandoned timber position remain above a clear ground strip. All four compositions inspected; no baked fire/smoke or later memorial. Not runtime execution.

backgrounds.name: Kozara
backgrounds.prompt: An intimate rolling Kozara woodland landscape: linked rounded forest ridges, descending wooded spurs, patches of deciduous and conifer trees and a small stream valley. Keep its lower rounded silhouette clearly distinct from Sutjeska's high rocky summit and deep mountain canyon. A roofless village outbuilding, snapped trunks and an abandoned earth-and-timber position make the war damage visible. No Mrakovica cylindrical monument, memorial stairs, museum or modern hotel. Open horizontal light dry-earth clearing across the foreground; no foreground trunks hiding units.

backgrounds.name: Sremski front
backgrounds.prompt: An open Srem plain under a broad cool sky, flat fields divided by sparse leafless trees, distant low farm roofs and clearly readable abandoned zigzag trenches with timber supports, rough wire and churned earth in the middle distance. No dramatic mountain ridge and no postwar memorial guns, monuments, museum or motorway. Damage consists of shelled farm roofs and cratered middle-ground fields; do not put craters or deep trenches in the continuous foreground driving strip. Keep the foreground a calm pale compacted-earth band with restrained texture.

backgrounds.name: Beograd
backgrounds.prompt: Kalemegdan fortress on its raised river promontory overlooking the confluence of the Sava and Danube. Compose from a low opposite-bank terrace, slightly elevated enough to read two broad river arms joining, with old layered ramparts and period low city roofs beyond. Keep the near bank clear for gameplay. Pobednik may appear as a small distant column silhouette because it predates WWII; no later memorials, high-rise Usce tower, New Belgrade apartment blocks, modern bridges or tourist facilities. Show shell-damaged ordinary riverside buildings, broken quay masonry and a ruined warehouse away from the foreground; no invented total destruction of the landmark fortress.

styleExploration.status: Three contrasting Bihac style studies complete, no owner selection or production integration. Existing detailed variants preserved; original batch remains stopped.
styleExploration.ownerFeedback: A has excessively large obvious pixels. B is partly acceptable, not finally approved. C is unsuitable. The owner requests wartime atmosphere including partisan graffiti, flags and scorched walls; current work is a targeted B2 study, not a resumed production batch.
styleExploration.humanPresence: Owner requests human wartime vignettes: machine-gun position on tower/church, hill sentry, corner patrol; during battle running, hiding or crawling. B3 is a scene-layout still, not animated production art.

referenceStorage: Research photos are represented by their original URLs and exact input hashes. Project reference PNGs and selected generated backgrounds are stored once at their canonical paths. Large composition PNGs are optional local outputs.
seasonPolicy: Choose vegetation, snow by elevation, ground and light from the selected battle date, not a universal autumn palette. Actual weather and water level are artistic choices unless sourced. New seasonal reserve selections are recorded in seasonal-backgrounds.json; original images/prompts are preserved.
